neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.instruction: Use a clear, matter-of-fact, balanced tone. Avoid jokes, hype, and emotional exaggeration.

funny.label: Funny
funny.description: Light humor and a playful touch.
funny.instruction: Use light, relatable humor and playful phrasing about learning to drive. Keep it kind; never mock learners or make unsafe driving sound acceptable.

friendly.label: Friendly
friendly.description: Warm and conversational, like a helpful friend.
friendly.instruction: Write warmly and conversationally, as a helpful driving instructor speaking directly to a learner. Use approachable, natural language.

professional.label: Professional
professional.instruction: Use a polished, confident, respectful tone with precise language. Avoid slang, jokes, and exaggerated claims of expertise.

educational.label: Educational
educational.description: A practical tip with a clear explanation.
educational.instruction: Teach one useful point clearly and explain why it matters. Use only supported information; do not invent traffic laws or statistics. For quizzes, encourage thinking without giving away or hinting at the answer.

motivational.label: Motivational
motivational.description: Encouraging, positive, and focused on progress.
motivational.instruction: Encourage steady practice and realistic progress with a positive, reassuring tone. Acknowledge that learning takes time; do not promise test success or guaranteed results.

storytelling.label: Storytelling
storytelling.description: A relatable moment with a useful takeaway.
storytelling.instruction: Frame the caption around a short, relatable scenario and a useful takeaway. Use a supplied real event faithfully, or clearly introduce a hypothetical situation. Never present an invented event as a personal experience or testimonial.

promotional.label: Promotional
promotional.description: Highlight the value and invite people to join.
promotional.instruction: Highlight the supplied course benefits with an inviting, persuasive tone and a clear call to action. Do not invent discounts, deadlines, scarcity, testimonials, or guarantees.
